name: LORATADINE / PHENYLEPHHRINE 5/30 MG 10 TABLETS PROLONGED RELEASE
description: Active ingredients: Loratadine (antihistamine) and Phenylephrine (nasal decongestant). Presentation: Extended-release tablets, generally available in boxes of 10. Therapeutic indication: This medication is indicated for the relief of symptoms associated with respiratory allergies, such as seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis. It combats symptoms such as nasal congestion, sneezing, runny nose, and itchy eyes and nose. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
